title: feat(news): send the wednesday model post through posts.py and deliver.py
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Moved the Wednesday model-news post to `posts.py` and `deliver.py`, replacing the old workflow, generator, publisher and prompt file. `news-posts.yml` schedules it for Wednesday at 14:00 UTC or accepts a manual `job: models` run; the post keeps the same Discord channel and role ping. Delivery through `deliver.py` is configured from 2026-10-14. The posts job retains its output with the run, and the deliver job commits the four comparison files only after a successful send, so a failed send does not advance next week's comparison. Weeks without model changes save only the snapshot. Fixture tests replace the old generator test; a frozen-catalog check found matching requests and output files apart from timestamps.
